pyrefly_preset_calibration.interpretation: The prior 2/5 observation was configuration-sensitive and cannot be promoted to a product-level coverage claim.

controlled.hooks: pre-commit and prek produced the same changed files, content SHA-256, and diff SHA-256 for the frozen parity fixture.
controlled.workspace: Nx and Turborepo both passed discovery and cache hit/invalidation checks; affected selection was correct in 5/6 recorded cases. Boundary capability remains unscored head-to-head because the official enforcement surfaces differ.

external_validity.boundary: Unknown real-repository defect ground truth means nonzero exits and output volume are operational observations only, not recall or quality rankings.

classification: A type-checker authority claim attaches to a tested execution contract, not a binary name alone.
Preset and configuration are part of that execution contract because the same Pyrefly version changed from 2/5 to 5/5 on the same frozen corpus when the preset changed from basic to default.
The repaired evidence does not support the prior product-level story that stable Pyrefly had lower frozen-corpus coverage than the other tested checkers.
The study does not establish universal checker accuracy; the corpus is deliberately small and real repositories lack complete defect ground truth.
